paid.title: Set it up for you
paid.about: Over a remote session you start: your games folder, emulators, controllers and TV, then a tour. Most take one to two hours.

paid.title: Tune your emulators
paid.about: Looks, speed, controller layouts and saves, for the consoles you play most.

paid.title: A look of your own
paid.about: Your name, logo, colours and sounds on Xsegon. Yours through every update.

paid.title: A cabinet or mini PC
paid.about: A small PC or an arcade cabinet that starts straight into Xsegon, built to order. Parts at what they cost.

steps: what you need, from Write to me or your own email.
I reply with a plan and a price.
Free, and no obligation. You get the total before any work.
Yes, no, or not now: all fine. Nothing is owed until you say yes.
How you pay depends on the job: we agree on it in writing before we start, and you get a receipt.

safe.title: One address
safe.text: I only ever write from help@tumultuousproductions.site. A message from anywhere else is not me.

safe.title: I only write back
safe.text: I only ever write back to messages you sent me. Xsegon never opens this page by itself.

safe.title: No passwords, no payment in Xsegon
safe.text: I never ask for a password, and Xsegon never takes payment or card numbers.

safe.title: You hold the keys
safe.text: A remote session only starts when you start it. You see everything, and you can end it any time.

safe.title: No games, BIOS files or keys
safe.text: I never sell, send or link to them, and nobody who does works with me. You bring your own; I help with everything else.

safe.title: Price first
safe.text: You get the price in writing before any work, and you only pay for what you said yes to.
